title: Smooth special and residue-field fibres on a prepared Popescu chart
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R, and compatible algebra structures R to Cbar and R/pi^2 to Cbar. Let d be prepared finite polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]: P=R[x_1,...,x_n], finitely many f_l, a_k, subsets E_k, coefficients h_{klj}, g_{kl}, and a surjection epsilon:(R/pi^2)[x] to Cbar with the prescribed kernel, smooth charts, conormal and differential bases, normalized coefficients and cleared relations. Put Q=P[z_1,...,z_m], u_l=f_l-pi z_l, p_{kl}=a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl}, D=ULift(Q/(u_l,p_{kl})), and D_0=D/pi D. Let c:Cbar to D_0 be an R-algebra map taking epsilon(X_i) to the original generator x_i of D_0. Fix a prime q of D_0 and a chart k with c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))) outside q. Put qD equal to the inverse image of q in D, and p equal to its contraction to R. Let cmod:Cbar/pi Cbar to D_0 be a ring map whose composite with the quotient projection is c. Then the fibre ring kappa(p) tensor_R D is smooth at the prime corresponding to qD [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. Also the principal localization (D_0)_{c(epsilon(reduced(a_k)))} is smooth over Cbar/pi Cbar for the algebra structure induced by cmod [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. No annihilator or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Write P=R[x], Q=P[z], u_l=f_l-pi z_l and p_{kl}=a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl}. Modulo pi and after inverting a_k, the cleared relation expresses every f_l in the ideal of the f_j with j in E_k. The normalized p_{kl} for l in E_k are zero. Eliminate z_l for l outside E_k using p_{kl}=0.

proof.text: For another chart k prime and j in E_k, set b_j=a_{k prime}h_{klj}-sum_{j prime in E_{k prime}}h_{k prime,l,j prime}h_{k,j prime,j}. Comparing the expressions for a_k a_{k prime} f_l in the reduced conormal module gives sum b_j f_j=0. The specified basis on chart k makes every b_j zero in Cbar localized at a_k. Equality in localization clears a power of a_k, placing that multiple in I+pi^2P. In D/pi D all f_l are already zero. The expansion a_k p_{k prime,l}-a_{k prime}p_{kl}+sum h_{k prime,l,j prime}p_{k,j prime}=sum b_j z_j modulo pi therefore makes every extra p relation redundant.

proof.text: The quotient after inverting a_k is consequently (Cbar/pi Cbar)_{a_k}[z_j : j in E_k]. The inverse sends each complementary z_l to a_k inverse times sum h_{klj}z_j. The two substitutions fix the original x_i and the remaining z_j, and their composites fix each eliminated z_l by its relation. Surjectivity and kernel of epsilon identify the coefficient quotient; the generator identity hc and the quotient identity hcmod identify its map with cmod. ULift is transported by its algebra equivalence.

proof.text: Principal localization of Cbar/pi Cbar is smooth over Cbar/pi Cbar. The polynomial algebra over it is smooth, and composition gives Smooth over Cbar/pi Cbar for the localization at c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))).

proof.text: Prepared.smooth, identified using epsilon, is smoothness of Cbar localized at epsilon(reduced(a_k)) over R/pi^2. Base change modulo pi gives smoothness of (Cbar/pi Cbar)_{a_k} over R/pi. Hence the displayed polynomial chart is smooth over R/pi. If qD is the inverse image of q in D and p its contraction to R, pi is zero in the residue field of p. Base changing the chart to that field gives the fibre algebra p.Fiber D localized at a_k. The prime corresponding to qD contracts to qD, so a_k avoids it by hk. This smooth principal localization witnesses smoothness at the fibre prime.

lean.statement:
theorem popescu_lift_chart_fibres (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (cmod : (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) →+*
      (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (hcmod : cmod.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = c.toRingHom)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (k : Fin d.r) (hk : c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k))) ∉ q.asIdeal) :
    let qD := PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) q
    let p := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra) qD
    IsSmoothAtPrime p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R d.liftingAlgebra p ⟨qD, rfl⟩) ∧
    @Smooth (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) _
      (Localization.Away (c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k))))) _
      (letI := cmod.toAlgebra; inferInstance)
